blocks.text: A graduate from Northern Iloilo State University - Main gained the highest percentage rating for the October 2026 Fisheries Professionals Licensure Examination, according to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC).
Gerson Celeste Berano garnered the percentage rating 90.25, the highest among 1,816 who successfully hurdled the examination.
